name: cc-resources
description: TutanDev's Claude Code plugins and resources

plugins.name: dmf
plugins.description: Domain Modeling Made Functional in C# for any codebase: domain discovery, type-driven modeling, Result-based workflow pipelines, DTOs and persistence, with DMF and functional-style reviewers.

plugins.name: lowy
plugins.description: Löwy's Method for larger systems: volatility-based decomposition, layered services, call chains, service wiring, verified multi-agent audits, and fitness tests. Installs dmf as a dependency.

plugins.name: devflow
plugins.description: Multi-agent development workflows on Löwy's Method and DMF: a feature plan format, and a plan review where one agent writes, blind Löwy, call-chain, DMF and delivery reviewers review, skeptics verify, a judge rules, and the writer revises. Installs lowy and dmf as dependencies.

plugins.name: house-rules
plugins.description: Three writing rules held at the tool call: no Claude attribution in commits or pull requests, no em dash in anything written, and one full sentence per line of Markdown.

plugins.name: workstation
plugins.description: The setup for every machine: installs and enables context7 and serena from Anthropic's official marketplace, sets the cc-resources status line when user settings have none, and allows the reads and writes the cc-resources workflows need.
